correctness.rationale: For all trees with exactly nine leaves, the 16/16 first-query condition reduces to (3,6), (4,5), (1,2,6); the direct-product lemma excludes the first and the disjoint eight-hypothesis lemma excludes the latter two. No bounded-vertex or finite-census assumption enters this upper bound. VC=0/1/2 follows from a three-vertex tree-path obstruction and four leaf-pair witnesses. For m=2..10, each lower-bound depth has a complete, distinct-terminal pair certificate; verify_cert.py independently reconstructs every actual path and calculates the exact rank of each explicit tree.

value.rationale: This establishes the first universal entropy-counting obstruction over an intrinsic leaf-count parameter for a natural geometric set system, proves it for arbitrary tree topology, degree and subdivision, gives a sharp threshold and next-size rebound, and identifies static VC dimension. The finite boundary is mathematically motivated by a 36-hypothesis potential depth-five tree and an explicit unachievable 16/16 split. A mathematical structural obstruction, not just a small numerical gain, explains the failure.
